referents.why: The sign adds a consequence for the November intake rota (fortnightly, starting 1 November): its dates will be printed at the intake desk. It does not push against the rota position.

resolutions.why: 'The rota dates from November' converges on the single intake-rota position, which sets the fortnightly rota starting 1 November. Nothing else in the graph concerns the intake rota, and no other node is a comparable candidate.
